annotations.title: Look up company by registry ID

description: Resolve exactly one company by its national registry identifier in a given country. Handles every identifier shape we carry (SK/CZ/EE IČO, AT Firmenbuch e.g. '187a', SI/LV registry numbers, …). Returns the core record: identity, address, legal form, status, NACE. For an LLM-ready summary prefer company_brief; for the full enrichment layer use get_company_details.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the register (e.g. SK, CZ, AT, PL). Strongly recommended: registry numbers are NOT unique across countries (an SK and a CZ company can share the same 8-digit IČO), and without it the server picks one by tie-break. Defaults to SK.

ico.description: National registry identifier (SK/CZ IČO, AT Firmenbuch number, PL KRS/REGON, FR SIREN, …). Leading zeros are normalised server-side.

purpose.description: Legal purpose for natural-person (FO) data, attested by the account holder. Only needed when the API key has full FO access; must be one of the purposes licensed on the key. Never guess it — ask the user if it is not known.

name: lookup_company

meta.description: Request metadata: request_id (quote it in support requests), duration_ms, cached.
